entity.summary: Active BNB Chain automated-market-maker decentralized exchange within Forest Protocol, with a live first-party product surface and current on-chain DEX activity.
entity.notes: HEI previously classified Forest as limited because the July 2026 review lacked a stable first-party site and strong recent utilization evidence. Current first-party Forest Protocol material is live at forest.inc and presents the BNB Chain product/trading surface. Current DefiLlama metrics report non-zero TVL and recent DEX volume for Forest V1, supporting active classification. The DefiLlama adapter start date is not promoted to an exact launch_date, and no lifecycle event is fabricated from routine activity.

evidence.title: Forest Protocol official website
evidence.notes: Current first-party site identifies Forest Protocol's BNB Chain product and exposes a live token/trading surface, supporting present operation.

evidence.title: Forest V1 current DEX metrics
evidence.notes: Current protocol metrics classify Forest V1 as a BNB Chain DEX/AMM and report non-zero TVL plus recent 30-day, 7-day, and 24-hour DEX volume, supporting active rather than limited classification.

evidence.title: Forest V1 DEX adapter configuration
evidence.notes: DefiLlama's maintained adapter configuration preserves Forest V1 on BNB Chain. Its adapter start timestamp is not treated by HEI as an exact first-party launch date.
